verdict.rationale: Finix documents automated dashboard reports (10+ types covering transactions, disputes, fees) and API/dashboard access to seller payouts and dispute data (finix-docs-24, finix-docs-12, finix-docs-17), plus webhooks for event-driven updates (finix-docs-19, finix-docs-28). However there is no explicit evidence of scheduled file exports, per-seller vs rolled-up settlement/balance report APIs, or documented integration patterns for finance-stack consumption on a schedule. missing for 10: dedicated reconciliation/settlement report API endpoints, scheduled file delivery (SFTP/CSV export), explicit per-seller vs aggregate balance reporting, and any third-party confirmation of reconciliation automation in practice.
